pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with diffuse, low-contrast pixel gradients at the edges. Patch area is significantly larger on the shoulder and upper flank compared to the more elongated, smaller geometries visible on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways forming a polygonal grid. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three or more pathways converge, exhibiting relatively uniform thickness with slight tapering at the vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous mane fringe along the upper neck and shoulder with high-frequency, low-amplitude vertical fiber protrusions creating a fine-grained serrated 1D silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced horizontal skin-fold striations visible at the ventral-lateral transition of the lower neck and shoulder.
